naId6925618.summary: Thomas Jordan, newly a lieutenant colonel, asks 'Rachel' (Rose Greenhow) to get him Hardee's and Scott's Tactics, Mahan's Field Fortification, 8 yards of navy-blue flannel and shoulder straps for his rank, to be sent by hand; the clear copy adds that he feared an earlier letter had failed to reach her: he had then no access to his cipher, and a letter in ordinary characters 'was intercepted' (the copy has gaps here). Domestic in content, but it shows the Jordan-Greenhow cipher in use in 1861 with the same key as in 1864.
naId6925618.en:
English, so no translation. Words read from cipher groups are in CAPITALS; clear words on the fragment are in lower
case; words or letters that are torn away on the fragment and supplied from the clerk's clear copy (naId 1634051
image 2) are in [brackets]; [...] = lost and not in the copy either; [?] = uncertain.

... to get for me HAR[dee's Tacti]CS, [or the n]EW COP[ies of] SCOTT['s Tact]ICS, [also ... vol]UMES [of Ma]HANS
FIELD FORTIFICATION[s], and if to be had conveniently 8 yards navy flannel (blue) [Indigo ...]ing of [SH]OULDER
[STR]APS for a LIE[utenant] CO[lonel. ... handed ...] he [will b]RIN[g] ANY you CAN G[et to] [H]IM, [and I will ...]
for the rest to [...] me from Alex[andria ...]. These BOO[ks are] essential to me in my position as LIEU[tenant]
COLONEL of IN[fantry] and you will [do me a great favor] by sending [them by hand ...].

system: The Jordan-Greenhow symbol substitution, one sign per letter, cipher groups for single words or parts of words inside a clear letter; the 1864 key sheet also has digraph and code signs.
